correctness.rationale: For finite T0 Alexandrov posets, height rank is strictly increasing along comparabilities and invariant under order automorphisms; each automorphism cycle stays in an antichain level of cardinality <=w. For each maximal prime power dividing the exact order t, assign a witness cycle; the sum of coprime assigned prime powers cannot exceed the cycle length. This proves per-level bin capacities and total cardinality n. Ordinal sums of antichains whose internal cycles have exactly the selected prime-power lengths construct sharp witnesses, including t=1 singleton. For width-only orders, every cycle length <=w divides lcm(1..w) and discrete m-cycles with freely valued atom show the universal exponent is minimal. Independent permutation-order/bucket computations exactly matched all 32 width-height cases w<=8,h<=4; no finite check substituted for the proof.
